0022600220.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-8, on a seven-game losing streak, 0-3 at home) host the San Antonio Spurs (8-2, on an eight-game winning streak, 4-0 on the road) in the Bulls' 10th game of the season. Chicago is without Norman Powell, who is out with shoulder inflammation and is averaging 19.3 points in 28.8 minutes per game this season, and Zach Collins, who is out with an illness, while San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Bulls lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 129-114 in San Antonio.
